label: XDCR Data-Type Conversion
type: the implicit procedure XDCR filtering uses to compare values of differing data types within a filtering expression, alongside xdcr:collation-comparison. There is no explicit, administrator-selected conversion mode.
evidence: All conversion performed by XDCR is implicit, meaning that it is performed automatically within the system. No explicit conversion (that is, data-type conversion selected and imposed by the administrator) is available.
Note that expressions that attempt to compare values whose data types differ from one another must be handled either by data-type conversion or by collation comparison.
relates_to_competency_question: When an XDCR filter expression compares values of two different data types, can an administrator choose how the comparison is resolved?
